hints.title: Player Score Association Map
hints.text: Store user scores keyed by playerId in a key-value mapping and extract top scores on demand.

hints.title: Min-Heap for Top K Sum
hints.text: Use a min-heap of size K when querying top(K) to avoid sorting all registered player records.

hints.title: Leaderboard Operations Blueprint
hints.text: addScore adds to map[playerId]. reset removes key from map. top(K) pushes scores into size K min-heap and returns sum.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(1) addScore, reset; O(P log K) top
complexity.notes: Min-heap maintains K largest scores in logarithmic time per player.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full array sorting on every top call takes O(P log P) time, which scales poorly with large player pools.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bounded size-K min-heap consumes O(K) temporary heap memory during top score reduction.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of min-heap of size K for top scores calculation.

solutions.approach: Hash Map with Bounded Min-Heap Top Reduction
C++ Hash Map with Priority Queue Top-K
